context: The skill should turn a parsed but unusable retry hint into absence with filter before the lazy fallback, instead of letting a negative duration skip the backoff.

checklist.name: Creates coherent Java 21 artifact
checklist.description: Creates WebhookRedelivery.java as Java 21-compatible code with pauseBefore, parseRetryIn, the RetryPolicy record, and the imports it needs.

checklist.name: Implements the fallback exactly
checklist.description: A usable Retry-In value is returned as that many seconds; a missing, blank, or non-numeric header and a null response fall back to policy.baseDelay().multipliedBy(1L << Math.min(attempt - 1, 6)).

checklist.name: Rejects a hint the sleep cannot use
checklist.description: A Retry-In value that parses but is negative does not reach the sleep: the Optional pipeline turns it into absence with filter (for example filter(d -> !d.isNegative()) or a check on the parsed number) before the fallback is chosen, so the exponential backoff applies. Zero stays a usable hint. Score 0 if a negative value is returned as a Duration or clamped to zero without the fallback.

checklist.name: Keeps the fallback lazy
checklist.description: The exponential backoff is computed inside orElseGet or an equivalent supplier, only when no usable hint exists; it is not computed before the header is examined.

checklist.name: Binds the header once
checklist.description: The header flows through Optional operations (ofNullable, flatMap, filter, map, orElseGet) from the response to the result; no isPresent or isEmpty followed by get or orElseThrow, no orElse(null), no null sentinel for the parsed duration.

checklist.name: Keeps the parse boundary narrow
checklist.description: parseRetryIn returns Optional.empty() for text that is not a whole number and Optional.of(Duration.ofSeconds(n)) otherwise, with no null returns and no generic Optional helper.

checklist.name: Keeps the change focused
checklist.description: Adds no retry loop, caches, extra public types, overloads, or logging beyond the two methods and the record.
